title: Session 2 — Participant 42 User + Claude Behavior Graphs
goal: Develop a complete outreach-ready prospecting campaign that identifies, qualifies, and prepares personalized messages for high-achieving women in Fort Lauderdale who are strong potential attendees for Live Iconic Live.
context: I work on lead generation, prospect research, and personalized outreach for events and business-growth opportunities. For this session, I will build a complete outreach campaign for Live Iconic Live, targeting successful, high-achieving women based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida who are building meaningful and distinctive businesses, careers, brands, or community initiatives and want greater growth, connection, visibility, and impact.
occupation: Sales Development Representative (SDR) / B2B Lead Generation Specialist / Appointment Setter

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: The workflow was more extensive than I initially estimated, and one hour was not enough to complete all the planned steps.

Step 1.step_action: Research and define the ideal prospect's location, professional background, achievements, aspirations, pain points, engagement signals, and qualification criteria

nodes.label: Narrate the session goal to camera
nodes.detail: Explains to camera that this section is about prompting Claude for the ICP needed for the project: developing a complete outreach-ready prospecting campaign that identifies, qualifies, researches, and personalizes outreach to high-achieving women in Fort Lauderdale, Florida as potential attendees for an event.

nodes.label: Send the ICP description and checklist request to Claude
nodes.detail: In a fresh Claude.ai chat, describes the ICP for Live Iconic Live (high-achieving women in Fort Lauderdale/Florida who own businesses, are founders/speakers/coaches/leaders, attend events, build meaningful connections) and asks Claude to turn it into a concise prospect qualification checklist, separating must-have criteria from strong-fit signals and disqualifiers, observable through LinkedIn and Instagram.

nodes.label: Deliver the prospect qualification checklist
nodes.detail: Produces the 'Live Iconic Live — Prospect Qualification Checklist,' organized into Must-Have Criteria (Florida/Fort Lauderdale location, founder/C-suite/coach-consultant-speaker standing, woman-owned/led positioning, active online presence, visible traction), Strong-Fit Signals (speaker activity, event-goer behavior, personal-brand focus, community building, visual polish, engagement quality, cross-platform presence, prior event investment, referral density), and Disqualifiers, plus practical notes on using LinkedIn vs. Instagram as evidence sources.

nodes.label: Review the checklist and decide whether to refine
nodes.detail: Narrates checking whether she is OK with everything Claude has given her, explaining that if not, she will redirect Claude until she gets the actual thing she is looking for.

nodes.label: Request a 3-tier scoring system
nodes.detail: Sends a follow-up prompt asking Claude, based on the qualification framework, to create a simple 3-tier scoring system (High Fit, Potential Fit, Low Fit) with specific evidence that would place a prospect in each category.

nodes.label: Deliver the 3-tier scoring system
nodes.detail: Delivers the tiering framework: High Fit (clears all must-haves plus 4+ strong-fit signals), Potential Fit (clears must-haves plus 1-3 signals), Low Fit (fails a must-have), each with example profiles and a quick-reference table, and offers to turn it into a fillable scorecard.

nodes.label: Review Claude's response about the 3-tier scoring system
Copy the finished criteria before moving to LinkedIn
nodes.detail: Copies the finished checklist/scoring lines out of the chat to reference during research, before switching over to post on LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Step 2.step_action: Use the ICP and qualification framework from Step 1 to research potential Live Iconic Live prospects across Instagram, Linkedin and relevant women's professional or business networks. Identify women in or strongly connected to Fort Lauderdale who demonstrate the professional profile, level of achievement, growth orientation, and engagement signals defined in the ICP. Record the strongest prospects and the evidence supporting their qualification, while excluding profiles that do not meet the core criteria.

nodes.label: Navigate to LinkedIn Sales Navigator and begin a search
nodes.detail: Switches to LinkedIn Sales Navigator, narrating that she will use the criteria developed for the ICP to search for leads.

nodes.label: Search for high-achieving women and set the geography filter
nodes.detail: Runs a people search for high-achieving women, setting the Geography filter to Fort Lauderdale/Miami-Fort Lauderdale Area.

nodes.label: Add job-title and seniority filters
nodes.detail: Adds Current Job Title filters (Owner, Chief Executive Officer, Founder, Co-Founder) and Seniority level = Senior, narrowing the initial ~29M-result pool down toward the matching set of profiles.

nodes.label: Continue refining the search filters
nodes.detail: Continues adjusting filters, narrating that each added filter narrows the results further to better support the search.

nodes.label: Note the lack of a gender filter and manually screen for women
nodes.detail: Narrates that Sales Navigator has no gender filter, so she must manually check for women among the results rather than filtering directly.

nodes.label: Manually select 10 matching profiles
nodes.detail: Reviews the filtered result set (677 matching profiles per the on-screen count) and manually checkbox-selects 10 women matching the ICP.

nodes.label: Save the selected leads to a new list
nodes.detail: Uses 'Save to list' to create a new lead list named 'New Leads For Live Iconic Live' holding the 10 selected women.

nodes.label: Manually copy each lead since bulk export isn't available
nodes.detail: Narrates that she cannot export all of this on her current plan, so she must manually copy each lead's information one at a time.

nodes.label: Paste each name and LinkedIn URL into a tracking sheet
nodes.detail: Manually copies out each selected lead's name and LinkedIn profile URL and pastes them into a new Google Sheet titled 'LinkedIn Leads For Research Study' (columns: LinkedIn Profile Name, LinkedIn URL), populating rows for Carmen Bellido-Wall, Gabi Rolon, Eva Palladino, Carmen Ohling, Debbie Wemyss, Halle Eavelyn, Katherina Capra, Esther Santamaria, and Heather Monahan.

nodes.label: Source an additional prospect on Instagram and save the sheet
nodes.detail: Switches over to Instagram, searching and opening individual profiles (e.g. 'vanessahernandezy,' a Miami motivational speaker) to source an additional prospect, adds 'donnaemma''s Instagram profile URL as an 11th row in the same tracking sheet, then saves the sheet.

Step 3.step_action: Review the initial prospect list against the ICP and qualification framework from Step 1. Verify each prospect's Fort Lauderdale/location relevance, professional role or business, accomplishments, current business or career focus, and observable signals of growth, visibility, connection, or impact. Research relevant details that could support personalized outreach, then assign each prospect a qualification tier and outreach priority based on the strength of the available evidence.

nodes.label: Return to Claude, import the collected list, and request an ICP evaluation
nodes.detail: Narrates going back to Claude to import the list gathered from the LinkedIn/Instagram search, then pastes the names and LinkedIn/Instagram URLs into the same Claude conversation, asking Claude to evaluate the prospects against the Live Iconic Live ICP, classify each as High/Potential/Low Fit with one or two evidence-based reasons, and not assume information that isn't provided.

nodes.label: Research each prospect via web search and deliver the ICP evaluation table
nodes.detail: Notes the uploaded CSV only has names and LinkedIn URLs with no bios, headlines, or activity, so rather than guess, runs a live web search and fetch for each of the 9 prospects one at a time, flagging a location conflict for Katherina Capra along the way (the LinkedIn URL points to a Miami-based Unity Grow founder while a separate contact-database listing shows a Katherina Capra based in Bolivia). Delivers the "Live Iconic Live — Prospect Evaluation Results" table classifying each prospect with cited evidence (e.g. Gabi Rolon = High Fit as a documented Fort Lauderdale networking-event host, Carmen Bellido-Wall = Potential Fit, Heather Monahan = High Fit with 332,000+ LinkedIn followers and a TED-speaker/author background, Katherina Capra = Low Fit pending the location conflict), plus a methodology note that all "Potential Fit" calls reflect LinkedIn-only evidence since Claude had no direct Instagram access.

nodes.label: Review Claude's prospect evaluation and copy it to the Google Doc
nodes.detail: Participant reviews Claude's evaluation table and copies the output into the Google Doc.

nodes.label: Manually spot-check prospects' Instagram profiles
nodes.detail: Participant manually opens and reviews several prospects' Instagram profiles to verify Claude's evaluations, narrating a plan to check five prospects and looking for additional useful profile details.

nodes.label: Switch to Insightly CRM to begin tracking prospects
nodes.detail: Switches to the Insightly CRM (crm.na1.insightly.com), narrating the plan to enter the qualified prospects and check them against the sales pipeline rather than tracking them only in the Google Sheet.

nodes.label: Browse System Settings before building the pipeline
nodes.detail: Opens System Settings and browses configuration areas (Users, Security/Permissions, Data Definitions, Data Management: Categories, Lead Statuses, Lead Sources, Lead Conversion, Opportunity Conversion) before starting to create the pipelines and stages.

nodes.label: Run and continue configuring the pipeline
nodes.detail: Continues setting up and running the new pipeline configuration.

nodes.label: Begin creating opportunity records
nodes.detail: Navigates to the Opportunity list and begins creating opportunity records for the qualified prospects, narrating having finished the pipeline setup and now moving on to creating the opportunities.

nodes.label: Enter each qualified prospect as an Organization record
nodes.detail: Uses the 'Add New Organization' modal to enter each qualified prospect's business as an organization record, filling in fields including Twitter handle, Email Domains, and Address Information (Billing Address/City/State/Postal code/Country plus a parallel Shipping Address block), tying each record to a pipeline/opportunity so the campaign can be tracked inside the CRM going forward.

Step 4.step_action: Develop personalized multi-touch outreach for the highest-priority prospects identified in Step 3. Use each prospect's verified professional background, business or career achievements, current work, interests, and relevant personalization signals to create an appropriate first-touch message and follow-up sequence for Instagram, LinkedIn, and email. Adapt the tone, opening, value proposition, and call to action to the prospect and communication channel while keeping the messaging natural and relationship-focused.

nodes.label: Prompt Claude for cold messaging templates
nodes.detail: Returns to the Claude conversation and asks it to write cold messaging templates for the Live Iconic Live prospects, emphasizing the need to personalize rather than send anything generic: 'i need you to write a cold messaging templates for Live Iconic Live prospects, remeber to personalize.'

nodes.label: Deliver five channel-ready outreach templates
nodes.detail: Delivers five cold-messaging templates (LinkedIn DM for High Fit/Founder or Speaker, LinkedIn DM for Potential Fit/Needs Warming, Instagram DM warmer/casual tone, a Follow-Up for no response, and a Warm Intro/Mutual Connection angle), each built around a required one-sentence personal hook, with fully personalized worked examples for Heather Monahan and Esther Santamaria.

nodes.label: Review Claude's outreach templates and define the personalization workflow
nodes.detail: Participant reviews Claude's five channel-ready outreach templates and explains that she will provide each prospect's name, Instagram bio, and one or two recent posts for Claude to personalize into a full DM outreach message.

nodes.label: Confirm the personalization approach and ask clarifying questions
nodes.detail: Confirms the workflow and asks which template angle fits (High Fit vs. Potential Fit framing) and which platform, noting it will pull a genuine hook from the actual bio/posts rather than a generic compliment.

nodes.label: Paste the prospect's Instagram bio into Claude
nodes.detail: Pastes the Instagram bio and profile details for 'closingsbymonica' (Luxury Real Estate | Investment Strategies, South Florida real estate & tax solutions, expanding across Europe and international buyer hubs) into the chat and asks Claude to personalize and write the message.

nodes.label: Classify the prospect and draft the personalized message
nodes.detail: Classifies Monica as 'Potential Fit' (South Florida-based, building her own book of business, but no recent posts yet showing speaking/community-leadership signals), then drafts a personalized opening hooking on her real-estate + tax-strategy niche and international expansion, using a softer close appropriate for a Potential-Fit prospect, and explains the reasoning behind the hook and tone choices.

nodes.label: Review the drafted message and judge it mostly good
nodes.detail: Reads through Claude's drafted Monica message, narrating a few impressions before settling into approval: 'Let's see, let's see... Okay, I like this... Okay, this is okay.'

Step 5.step_action: Review the complete campaign against the ICP and qualification framework. Check the prospect list for inaccurate or missing information, duplicate records, weak qualification decisions, insufficient personalization, inappropriate tone, unclear calls to action, and gaps or repetition in the follow-up sequence. Make the necessary corrections and organize the final prospects and messaging into an outreach-ready campaign and tracking sheet.

nodes.label: Dictate final formatting corrections by voice
nodes.detail: Uses voice dictation to ask Claude for a final round of corrections: remove all the hyphens from the message, and after 'Hi Monica' add a comma and drop down to the body on its own line, matching a proper letter-opening format.

nodes.label: Deliver the corrected, letter-formatted message
nodes.detail: Confirms the request (no em dashes, name on its own line followed by a comma and a line break into the body) and returns the cleaned-up 'Hi Monica,' version of the message.

nodes.label: Confirm satisfaction and end the session
nodes.detail: Reviews the corrected version and confirms satisfaction to camera — 'Perfect... Okay, so I'm done' — ending the recorded session.

Step 1.step_action: Research and define the ideal prospect's location, professional background, achievements, aspirations, pain points, engagement signals, and qualification criteria

rubrics: ICP Alignment. The ICP clearly identifies the characteristics of a strong Live Iconic Live prospect, including Fort Lauderdale/location relevance, professional or business profile, level of achievement, growth orientation, and alignment with the event's target audience

Qualification Specificity. The framework provides specific criteria for distinguishing high-fit prospects from women who may appear successful but do not demonstrate sufficient relevance, interest, or alignment with the event

Verifiable Prospect Signals. The qualification criteria include observable signals that can be verified through sources such as Instagram, LinkedIn, Apollo.io, company websites, Google search, and other prospect research tools, rather than relying on assumptions

Actionable Prospect Prioritization. The framework provides enough information to categorize prospects by strong fit, potential fit, or low fit, allowing the highest-value prospects to be prioritized for outreach

Ready for Prospect Research and Outreach. The final ICP can be directly applied to individual prospects and provides enough guidance to support the next workflow steps: finding prospects, qualifying them, identifying relevant information for personalization, and preparing outreach messages

ratings.output_quality_reason: The agent completed the required tasks and provided the necessary outputs.

goal_achievement.Why or why not: The agent used all the necessary inputs and provided the correct results.
